item.title: WATCH LIVE: NORAD NOW TRACKING SANTA LIVE, Santa Is On His Way To Brevard County!
item.description: Every year on December 24, 1,500 volunteers staff telephones and computers to answer calls and e-mails from children (and adults) from around the world. Live updates are provided through the NORAD Tracks Santa Web site (in seven languages), over telephone lines, and by e-mail to keep curious children and their families informed about Santa’s whereabouts and if it’s time to get to bed.
